label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler On McIlroy's Jab
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said golf lacks true rivalries and his main rival is the course, responding to Rory McIlroy calling Bryson DeChambeau's rules penalty 'performative' and 'for attention' at The Open.

items.headline: Rahm On LIV Golf's Future
items.text: Jon Rahm said LIV Golf officials keep players informed amid financial and legal uncertainty, but he did not confirm his participation next season.

items.headline: Jason Day Withdraws
items.text: Jason Day withdrew from this week’s 3M Open in Minnesota due to a back injury, affecting the tournament field.
